```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
detach("package:raster", unload = TRUE)
```

#Read in and collate all the files in the Processed Data folder 
```{r}

##SO4/Cl

#2022
dionex_files_2022 <- list.files(path = "../Sulfate_Chloride/Synoptic-CB/2022/Processed Data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
#Read and combine all CSVs
dionex_2022 <- dionex_files_2022 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
#Select Rhizon data MSM_202210_TR_RHZ_10
dionex_RHZ_2022 <- dionex_2022 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "RHZ")) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = str_remove(Sample_ID, "^[^_]*_"))
#Select only data columns
colnames(dionex_RHZ_2022)
dionex_RHZ_sel_2022 <- dionex_RHZ_2022 %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "SO4_ppm",   "Cl_ppm",    "SO4_mM" ,   "Cl_mM"   ,  "salinity" )

#2023
dionex_files_2023 <- list.files(path = "../Sulfate_Chloride/Synoptic-CB/2023/Processed Data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
#Read and combine all CSVs
dionex_2023 <- dionex_files_2023 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
#Select Rhizon data MSM_202210_TR_RHZ_10
dionex_RHZ_2023 <- dionex_2023 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "RHZ")) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = str_remove(Sample_ID, "^[^_]*_"))
#Select only data columns
colnames(dionex_RHZ_2023)
dionex_RHZ_sel_2023 <- dionex_RHZ_2023 %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "SO4_ppm",   "Cl_ppm",    "SO4_mM" ,   "Cl_mM"   ,  "salinity" )

#Combine 2022 and 2023
dionex_RHZ_sel <- bind_rows(dionex_RHZ_sel_2022, dionex_RHZ_sel_2023)


##Sulfide
#2022
sulfide_files_2022 <- list.files(path = "../Sulfide/Synoptic-CB/2022/Processed Data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
#Read and combine all CSVs
sulfide_data_2022 <- sulfide_files_2022 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
#Select Rhizon data
sulfide_RHZ_2022 <- sulfide_data_2022 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "RHZ"))
#Select only data columns
colnames(sulfide_RHZ_2022)
sulfide_RHZ_sel_2022 <- sulfide_RHZ_2022 %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "H2S_mean"     ,    "H2S_sd"        ,   "H2S_cv"          ,
"H2S_Conc_flag"  ,  "H2S_cv_flag"   ,   "H2S_QAQC_flag"  , "Run_notes",        "Field_notes") %>% 
  rename(H2S_Run_notes = Run_notes)

#2023
sulfide_files_2023 <- list.files(path = "../Sulfide/Synoptic-CB/2023/Processed Data", pattern = "Combined\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
# 3. Read and combine all CSVs
sulfide_data_2023 <- sulfide_files_2023 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
#Select Rhizon data
sulfide_RHZ_2023 <- sulfide_data_2023 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "RHZ"))
#Select only data columns
colnames(sulfide_RHZ_2023)
sulfide_RHZ_sel_2023 <- sulfide_RHZ_2023 %>% 
  rename(H2S_mean = H2S_mean_uM, 
         H2S_sd = H2S_sd_uM) %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "H2S_mean"     ,    "H2S_sd"        ,   "H2S_cv"          ,
"H2S_Conc_flag"  ,  "H2S_cv_flag"   ,   "H2S_QAQC_flag"  , "Run_notes",        "Field_notes") %>% 
  rename(H2S_Run_notes = Run_notes)

#Combine 2022 and 2023
sulfide_RHZ_sel <- bind_rows(sulfide_RHZ_sel_2022, sulfide_RHZ_sel_2023)


##Nutrients
#2022
nutr_files_2022 <- list.files(path = "../Nutrients/Synoptic-CB/2022/Processed Data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
nutr_data_2022 <- nutr_files_2022 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
nutr_data_2022 <- nutr_data_2022 %>%
  rename(Sample_ID = Sample_Name)
#Select Rhizon data
nutr_RHZ_2022 <- nutr_data_2022 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "RHZ"))
##Nutr MSM_202211_RHZ_WC_9 data is formatted differently from MSM_202210_WC_RHZ_9
nutr_RHZ_2022 <- nutr_RHZ_2022 %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = ifelse(Date == "202211", paste(Site, Date, Replicate, Zone, Depth, sep = "_"), Sample_ID))
#Select only data columns
colnames(nutr_RHZ_2022)
nutr_RHZ_sel_2022 <- nutr_RHZ_2022 %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "NH3_mgL"  , "NH3_uM"  ,  "PO4_mgL" , "PO4_uM"  ,  "NOx_mgL"   ,"NOx_uM"  ,  "NH3_range", "PO4_range", "NOx_range" , "Run_notes")  %>% 
  rename(Nutr_Run_notes = Run_notes)
##Select unique rows because there are 4 of the same for each sample
nutr_RHZ_sel_unique_2022 <- unique(nutr_RHZ_sel_2022)

#2023 - No 2023 Rhizon Data? 
nutr_files_2023 <- list.files(path = "../Nutrients/Synoptic-CB/2023/Processed Data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
nutr_data_2023 <- nutr_files_2023 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
#Select Rhizon data
nutr_RHZ_2023 <- nutr_data_2023 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "RHZ"))
##Nutr MSM_202211_RHZ_WC_9 data is formatted differently from MSM_202210_WC_RHZ_9
nutr_RHZ_2023 <- nutr_RHZ_2023 %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = ifelse(Date == "202211", paste(Site, Date, Replicate, Zone, Depth, sep = "_"), Sample_ID))
#Select only data columns
colnames(nutr_RHZ_2023)
nutr_RHZ_sel_2023 <- nutr_RHZ_2023 %>%
  select("Sample_ID", "NH3_mgL"  , "NH3_uM"  ,  "PO4_mgL" , "PO4_uM"  ,  "NOx_mgL"   ,"NOx_uM"  ,  "NH3_range", "PO4_range", "NOx_range" , "Run_notes")  %>%
  rename(Nutr_Run_notes = Run_notes)
##Select unique rows because there are 4 of the same for each sample
nutr_RHZ_sel_unique_2023 <- unique(nutr_RHZ_sel_2023)

#Combine 2022 and 2023
# nutr_RHZ_sel_unique <- bind_rows(nutr_RHZ_sel_unique_2022, nutr_RHZ_sel_unique_2023)
nutr_RHZ_sel_unique <- nutr_RHZ_sel_unique_2022


##Iron - need to collate 2022 data?
#2022
iron_files_2022 <- list.files(path = "../Iron/Synoptic-CB/2022/Processed Data", pattern = "Summary_Data\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
# 3. Read and combine all CSVs
iron_data_2022 <- iron_files_2022 %>%
  lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
#Select Rhizon data
iron_RHZ_2022 <- iron_data_2022 %>%
  rename(Sample_ID = Sample_Name) %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "Rhizon")) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = gsub("Rhizon", "RHZ", Sample_ID))
#Select only data columns
colnames(iron_RHZ_2022)
iron_RHZ_sel_2022 <- iron_RHZ_2022 %>% 
  select("Sample_ID", "FE_2_mean" ,"FE_2_sd"  ,"FE_3_mean" ,"FE_3_sd" ,  "FE_2_flag" ,"FE_3_flag")

#2023 - Iron data not processed
# iron_files_2023 <- list.files(path = "../Iron/Synoptic-CB/2023/Processed Data", pattern = "Summary_Data\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
# # 3. Read and combine all CSVs
# iron_data_2023 <- iron_files_2023 %>%
#   lapply(read.csv, colClasses = "character") %>%    # or read.csv if you prefer base R
#   bind_rows()             # combine into one data frame
# #Select Rhizon data
# iron_RHZ_2023 <- iron_data_2023 %>%
#   rename(Sample_ID = Sample_Name) %>%
#   filter(str_detect(Sample_ID, "Rhizon")) %>% 
#   mutate(Sample_ID = gsub("Rhizon", "RHZ", Sample_ID))
# #Select only data columns
# colnames(iron_RHZ_2023)
# iron_RHZ_sel_2023 <- iron_RHZ_2023 %>% 
#   select("Sample_ID", "FE_2_mean" ,"FE_2_sd"  ,"FE_3_mean" ,"FE_3_sd" ,  "FE_2_flag" ,"FE_3_flag")

#Combine 2022 and 2023
# iron_RHZ_sel <- bind_rows(iron_RHZ_sel_2022, iron_RHZ_sel_2023)
iron_RHZ_sel <- iron_RHZ_sel_2022


##Combine all analytes by Sample ID
# Create a list of your data frames
df_list <- list(dionex_RHZ_sel, sulfide_RHZ_sel, nutr_RHZ_sel_unique, iron_RHZ_sel)
# Join them all together
joined_data <- df_list %>% 
  reduce(full_join, by = "Sample_ID")

```

##Write out files
```{r write out combined data and metadata, include=FALSE}

#write out a csv of all the data to the main folder: 
write.csv(joined_data, "COMPASS_SynopticCB_Rhizon_Data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
